standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness as preservation of exactness
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps the exact sequences exact after tensoring, which is what produces the required prime.

standard_prerequisites.name: Support of a finite module over the base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used to translate the topological statement (lines 10076-10080)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the primes in the support with the nonvanishing localisations.

core_obligations: Unwind the topological statement: given primes of the base contained in one another and a prime of the source in the support above the larger one, one must find a smaller prime of the source still in the support above the smaller base prime (proof lines 10076-10080).

Produce that prime by tensoring the localisation of the module with the residue field of the smaller prime and exhibiting a prime of the resulting ring, using flatness to keep the relevant sequences exact (proof lines 10080-10098).
proof_roadmap: Translate generality lifting into a statement about a smaller prime in the support (proof lines 10075-10080).
Build it by tensoring with the residue field and taking a prime (proof lines 10080-10099).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a finite module flat over the base ring, generalisations lift along the support of the module (statement lines 10068-10073). The proof unwinds the topological statement into a concrete demand for a smaller prime of the source over a smaller prime of the base and produces it by tensoring the localised module with the residue field of the smaller base prime, keeping the relevant sequences exact by flatness (proof lines 10075-10099). Choosing the residue field tensor product as the ring in which to exhibit that prime is the step that carries the argument. H2.
